_comment: Deterministic fixture for the plugin safety harness. Seeds the NHL season-schedule cache (key nhl_schedule_2025) with one final, one in-progress, and one scheduled game so recent/upcoming render real game cards without network access. Live mode is disabled: NHLLiveManager._fetch_data() -> _fetch_todays_games() is a direct network call with no cache read and no test_mode passthrough in _adapt_config_for_manager, so the live screen can never be fed from mock data and would render blank after ~30s of connection retries per render. The huge update_intervals.live keeps the always-instantiated live manager from attempting that doomed network fetch on every update() (under freeze_time, now - last_update stays below it), keeping CI runs fast.
